jobs.occupation: Head of Software Customer Support Projects
jobs.description:
Would you like to grow professionally in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market within sortation of luggage in airports and parcels for logistics companies? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join us to apply your expertise within portfolio management of complex software solutions for logistics centres and airports worldwide. Take on this exciting and demanding leadership challenge to help us deliver vital infrastructure solutions.

Join a software center of excellence

You join BEUMER Group to manage a portfolio of technically complex software projects & products for automated baggage handling systems and parcel sorters. These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Set the direction

Specifically, you become a member of the software leadership team in Aarhus, where you assume the overall responsibility for a growing software department of +30 project managers, architects and developers. Here, you set the direction and run the portfolio of Software Customer Support projects including coordination with teams from other Group Companies. You also contribute to and review proposals and do capacity planning for current and future activities. This includes utilizing resources from other Group Companies.

Take on budget and project responsibility

You become accountable for the budget and project execution of all Software Customer Support projects up to medium size, overseeing up to 50 projects of duration from a few months up to 2-3 years. It is your job to guide, support and coach the responsible software project managers, so we can deliver on-time and within agreed budget, scope and quality.

Software Product

Our solutions are built on a number of core products developed by BEUMER. You provide input and ideas to product managers in the product department but in the Software Customer Support department you also take responsibility for maintenance of the legacy products developed by BEUMER.

Facilitate great collaborations

As you do so, you monitor the progress of the project portfolio, implement corrective actions when needed, and provide your support by attending meetings with customers, partners and suppliers. But just as important, you collaborate with your peers in other divisions and departments to facilitate good collaboration in order to ensure that the software and electro mechanic components come together as an integrated system.

Skilled portfolio manager

As Head of Software Customer Support Projects, your task is to enable your organization, so it can deliver the high-quality software projects needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a master’s degree and have worked in a similar role, as department or portfolio manager, where you have managed complex software development projects, including budget management.

• Knows about application management / product lifecycle management

• Thrive in a fast-paced international project environment, where making decisions, handling several projects at once and keeping good relations to stakeholders is the key to your success

• Are an experienced leader of leaders and know how to develop and support employees, creating buy-in and setting a direction.

• Knowledge about software development processes like Scrum, CMMI, ITIL and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

• You are PMI, IPMA or Prince2 certified or have a similar training/certification

• Can travel minimum 40 days a year to customers all over the world, and you are able to conduct negotiations in spoken and written English.

To lead a department of committed and highly skilled specialists, you will need drive, energy and people skills. Also, having the overall responsibility for mission critical systems, and working in a project culture, you need a high sense of urgency, and the ability to apply corrective actions in case of potential project risks. And you have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives, so we stay a preferred partner.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 31 76 04 48.

If you would like to play a committed part in our successful family business, you can apply online at beumergroup.com/career.

We look forward to welcoming you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, serration and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

The role includes approximately 30-50 travel days annually across the Nordics.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

About us:

Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Technical Operations team.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Templafy, you will play a critical role in supporting our growth by working directly with strategic customers to design, build, and deploy tailored solutions that bring Templafy’s platform into their real-world environments.

You will take deep technical ownership of the customer journey—from initial discovery and solution design through implementation and launch. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their most complex document workflows and build the environments, integrations, and AI-powered solutions needed to solve them.

This is a highly collaborative and customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and commercial strategy.

What You’ll Do

Embedded Customer Engineering

Work on-site or virtually alongside strategic customers to build, configure, and integrate Templafy solutions directly into their document workflows.

Custom Solution Development

Design and build tailored customer environments using their content, business rules, integrations, knowledge, and data to address complex document use cases and deliver solutions that meet their specific needs.

Technical Discovery & Architecture Mapping

Partner with Solutions Consulting and Professional Services to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into concrete technical architectures and implementation plans.

Rapid Prototyping

Build proof-of-concept integrations, document agents, and workflow automations to quickly validate solution fit before moving into full implementation.

Product Collaboration

Work closely with Product Managers to share insights and feedback from real-world customer use cases, helping shape the product and ensure our document agents continue to meet evolving customer needs.

Deployment & Change Management

Support customer rollout, training, and adoption of custom-built solutions, ensuring a smooth transition to the customer’s internal teams and Templafy’s Customer Success organization.

Accelerate Packaging & Repeatability

Use insights gained from customer implementations to partner with our Pricing and Packaging team to identify common use cases and help develop repeatable solutions across industries and business functions.

What We’re Looking For

• Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar technical customer-facing role, ideally within enterprise SaaS or applied AI.

• Strong commercial and technical discovery skills, with the ability to translate business needs and technical requirements into working solutions.

• Ability to identify gaps during discovery and proactively engage the appropriate customer stakeholders to gather the information needed to move forward.

• Experience working with REST APIs, enterprise integrations, authentication/SSO, and automation frameworks.

• Strong technical curiosity and interest in AI. Experience integrating with or building on top of LLM providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic is a strong plus.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and turning loosely defined customer problems into working software.

• Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, recommendations, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Understanding of enterprise document governance and workflows, with the confidence to engage directly with senior and C-level IT stakeholders.

• Strong technical and user-facing knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint, and their file structures is a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel and spend time on-site with customers as needed.

• A strong bias toward action, ownership, and problem-solving in a fast-moving and innovative environment.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role will include:

• Identifying complex business document scenarios and developing solutions that are successfully implemented in customers’ production environments.

• Enabling customers to successfully launch custom document agents and solutions.

• Supporting strong win rates for Custom Document Agent opportunities.

• Driving repeat end-user adoption of Custom Document Agents.

• Turning customer-specific learnings into insights that can improve Templafy’s product and create repeatable solutions for future customers.

Employee Benefits:

• Employee equity program

• Private health insurance

• Company lunch contribution

• Phone and broadband covered by company

• Centrally located office – easy access to public transportation

• Company events and team activities

• Flexible work environment

• Gympass Subscription

• Calm App Subscription

At Templafy, we’re all about building an inclusive culture where talented people come together to spark creativity in a dynamic, collaborative space. Strong relationships and teamwork are at the core of everything we do, and with our flat structure, everyone’s ideas count regardless of your role or experience.

We’re big on social events that foster connection and build a diverse, empowering community. From celebrating milestones to participating in employee resource groups or eating lunch together, we create space for meaningful team bonding.

Our mission goes beyond just building a product; we’re shaping the future, and we’d love for you to be a part of this epic journey with us.

Templafy is a workplace of belongingness. To us this means that you have a voice, you dare to speak up, and your voice is heard. We focus on offering an environment that allows all employees to feel that they belong regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or other status.

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. • Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive and curious student worker to join our Public Affairs Europe team. This is a unique opportunity to step into a highly visible role where personality, initiative, and strong interpersonal skills matter just as much as experience. In this role, you will support political engagement across multiple European markets, stakeholder coordination, and the operational excellence that makes strategic work possible.

You will gain direct exposure to a leading oncology biotech’s European policy landscape, develop insight into pharmaceutical policy and political strategy, and experience the dynamics of multi-market stakeholder engagement. At the same time, you will build hands-on experience in vendor management, procurement processes, and contract administration.

We are a small and agile team in Europe, currently the only Public Affairs presence in the region, working closely with colleagues in the US and across markets. This role is ideal for someone who is a self-starter, confident in sharing ideas, and not afraid to speak up. You enjoy working with others, building relationships, and navigating different stakeholders with empathy and strong communication skills. We offer flexibility around exams and study schedules, and an inclusive, supportive team environment where you are encouraged to grow and contribute from day one. Intended start date: 1 / 15 May.

Help us get to know you by submitting a comprehensive application, including your CV and motivational letter!

Responsibilities

Public Affairs

• Helping the team stay on top of political developments and initiatives across Europe.

• Supporting contact with different stakeholders like governments, patient organisations, and health authorities.

• Assisting in organising meetings and roundtables with external partners across European markets.

• Helping prepare clear and simple summaries, briefings, and communication materials.

• Supporting the organisation of events and conferences.

Operations & Administration

• Assisting with setting up and managing suppliers (vendors)

• Helping out with day-to-day administrative tasks where needed

• Supporting budget tracking and keeping an overview of costs

• Assisting with purchase orders and procurement processes

• Helping manage contracts and agreements

Requirements

• Actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program with approximately 2 years remaining before graduation.

• Based in Denmark, with a background in Political Science, Business, Public Health, Communications, or a related social science.

• Motivated by both political engagement and high-quality administrative execution.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed.

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and managing processes efficiently.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as it's Genmab's primary language.

• Available for approximately 20 hours per week.

About You

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving

• You are a generous collaborator who can work in teams with a broad spectrum of backgrounds

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to)

• You work hard and are not afraid to have a little fun while you do so!

Locations

Genmab maximizes the efficiency of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are crafted as open, community-based spaces that work to connect employees while being immersed in our powerful laboratories. Whether you’re in one of our office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

About Us

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose guiding its unstoppable team to strive towards improving the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For more than 20 years, its passionate, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and leveraged translational research and data sciences, which has resulted in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators, effector function enhanced antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates. To help develop and deliver novel antibody therapies to patients, Genmab has formed 20+ strategic partnerships with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO™) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with locations in Utrecht, the Netherlands, Princeton, New Jersey, U.S. and Tokyo, Japan.

Are you passionate about recruitment and eager to gain hands-on experience in the field of People and Culture? Do you want to enhance your skills in recruitment while fostering employee engagement and well-being? Are you ready to join an international green-tech company where your ideas can truly make a difference for people?

Here is what your role entails

During your internship, you will play an important role in driving a people-focused recruitment process and ensuring a great experience for every candidate. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to explore other areas within People & Culture, based on your interests and career aspirations.

More specifically, you will be:

• Partnering with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process from A-Z

• Taking ownership of the for recruiting new the Interns for the Spring semester of 2027

• Conducting qualitative and quantitative surveys and providing the P&C with data-based insights

• Supporting onboarding activities, and helping create engaging internship experience in social events and courses throughout the internship program

You will experience the freedom to explore your interests and take ownership of your own projects, giving you valuable insight into how People & Culture works in practice. With a thorough onboarding and continuous guidance from your mentor, we will support you throughout your entire internship.

Meet your future team

In this role you will become a part of our P&C Global Excellence & Operations team consisting of 16 talented colleagues. We are a tight-knit group working collaboratively to attract and hire candidates while ensuring the smooth operation of our global P&C processes. You will be part of a skilled, dynamic, and diverse team that values personal development, initiative, and collaboration, supporting each other to bring out the best in both the team and the organization.

Did you know? We have a previous Danish champion in Pétanque on our team, and 6 of us started our journey in Kamstrup as Interns.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an Intern who is ready to contribute to Kamstrup’s recruitment efforts and help drive our global recruitment and P&C initiatives. You may not have much experience yet, but the most important thing is that you are motivated to make your mark within our people operations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a master´s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Educational Science or another relevant field

• Thrive in a communicating role, enabling you to establish good professional collaborations

• Have a structured and analytical approach to your work

• Can work independently, and like having responsibility for your own tasks

• Are curious and eager to learn, and bring a positive mindset to new challenges and collaborations

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

You enjoy working across disciplines and are confident engaging with project managers, technical specialists, customers, contractors, and suppliers. You bring a structured and analytical approach while being able to communicate complex information in a clear and practical way.

• Extensive experience in project planning and project controls, preferably from large and complex energy, infrastructure, construction, or engineering projects.

• Strong experience developing, managing, and integrating complex project schedules.

• Strong working knowledge of Primavera and MS Project. Primavera OPC experience is a requirement.

• Experience with progress monitoring, critical path analysis, baseline management, schedule risk assessments and what-if analysis.

• Experience reviewing and validating contractor and supplier schedules.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to turn complex schedule information into clear and actionable decision support.

• Excellent oral and written Danish skills.

Experience from major energy infrastructure, transmission, utilities or other large-scale construction projects in Denmark will be a strong advantage.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility, and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide for our customers. **

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com or Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui at iatu@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and fora.
